summary: Backend + frontend tested for Leadership Library (39 books, daily shelf of 12) and CXO Strategy Simulation games (6 games). All 12 pytest cases pass and every frontend flow (shelf/all toggle, ritual sections, page-flip reader, conditional Watch tab, games grid, full 5-round play + replay reset) works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4884 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Split into routers (auth, library, games, admin, security) for maintainability.

curator.book_videos results are treated as best-effort: get_book swallows all exceptions to [] which is fine, but caching-status (fresh vs stale vs failed) isn't surfaced to clients — consider a 'videos_available' boolean.
/api/books/{slug}/text has no scheduled cache eviction; _BOOK_TEXT_CACHE grows unbounded across restarts of long-lived pods. Small (39 titles) so acceptable, worth a note.
list_books accepts any string for `scope`; only 'all' is meaningful — treat unknown scope as 400 or document the default silently returning shelf.
Score endpoint returns 0 for unknown option ids silently — could return 400 for invalid answer payloads to surface client bugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_library_and_games.py — run from /app/backend with `python -m pytest tests/test_library_and_games.py`. Frontend flows verified via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note: tao-te-ching currently DOES surface a Watch tab because YouTube scraping returned videos for that title today — this is per-request logic (Watch appears only when videos.length > 0), so it's correct behaviour rather than a bug. 401 console errors seen during library/games navigation are pre-existing /api/auth/me calls when not logged in, unrelated to this feature batch.
